messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On Sat, Nov 19, 2022, İmren Bayıl via AMBER wrote:
>I am trying to install gmx_MMPBSA ubuntu app on windows.
gmx_MMPBSA is a Gromacs program, and it is unlikely that you will get much
help on this mailing list. Check with the Gromacs folks.
...dac
